terminals.title: Between terminals
terminals.text: The free NIA Shuttle Bus connects domestic Terminal T1 and international Terminal T2. At T1, boarding is in Wing A on Level 1.

kids.title: Family services
kids.text: Free strollers are available after security: in Terminal T1 and Hall E on Level 2, and in Terminal T2 on Levels 2 and 3. T2 has 2 baby care rooms after security on Level 3; changing tables are also provided in some terminal toilets.

wifi.title: Free Wi-Fi
wifi.text: Free Wi-Fi is available in passenger waiting areas of the domestic and international terminals. Select @Airport Free Wifi - Goldsun and press Connect to the Internet on the page that opens automatically. Equipment installation is still ongoing in the expanded part of T2.
